payload.description: Uncommitted work in main checkout wiped by bulk file restore at 2026-09-10 23:40:52 (git checkout -- ./git restore . signature: 9 files sharing one write timestamp, neighbors untouched). Concurrent-session hazard: a fix round to commit 2e1a2951 (herdr batch-tab feature) was written, tested green, but never git-add'ed before another process restored the working tree to HEAD -- unrecoverable from git (never staged, no blob). Re-implemented from the authoring agent's own conversation context and re-committed as c256a284. Risk: any session with uncommitted changes in this shared main checkout can lose that work to a concurrent session's reset/restore/checkout with no warning and no git-level recovery path. Needs investigation into what tool/flow does bulk working-tree restores against the shared main checkout (main-checkout-reset? fgos catchup? an editor sync?) and whether a guard/warning is feasible before such a restore runs against a checkout with real uncommitted changes.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
